name: ggs-remote
description: Use Git Graph Studio from a phone or another computer: one link and a password per PC, every window of it, served by a low-memory tray daemon over HTTPS and a binary WebSocket (ggs-remote/1).

commands.title: Show Pairing QR Code in the Browser

ggsRemote.port.description: The port of this PC's remote access link.

ggsRemote.bind.description: The address the link listens on (127.0.0.1 behind a tunnel or reverse proxy).

ggsRemote.tlsMode.description: self-signed: a local CA the devices trust once; custom: your own certificate; none: plain HTTP on loopback only (a tunnel ends TLS).

ggsRemote.tlsCertPath.description: custom TLS: the certificate chain (PEM), e.g. from `tailscale cert`.

ggsRemote.autostart.description: Start the background service at login, and restart it after a crash.

ggsRemote.spawnVisible.description: Windows opened from a remote device also show on this PC's desktop.

ggsRemote.mdns.description: Announce the link on the local network (mDNS).

ggsRemote.hubUrl.description: Reach this PC from anywhere through your own relay (a ggs-remote-hub server): its address, or the whole ggsr1: connect string. Empty = LAN only.

ggsRemote.hubJoinKey.description: The relay's server password, when it has one (also #… inside the connect string).
